description: Original hybrid rule: trend and mean-reversion enabled with 0.60/0.40 probability bands.
Only trades baseline trend entries, but flips the sign to test whether trend mode is backwards.
Trend-only gate, flipped sign; mean-reversion state cannot block inverse-trend entries.
Pure inverse-trend with stricter P(trend)>=0.65 and |trend_score|>=1.50 entry.
Disables trend entries and requires P(trend)<=0.35 plus |displacement|>=1.50 for mean reversion.
Strict mean-reversion has priority; otherwise trade strict inverse-trend entries.
Hybrid rule with wider probability bands: trend >=0.65 and mean reversion <=0.35.
